title: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Peppers
description: Italian sausages roasted on a sheet pan with peppers and onions until everything is blistered and caramelized. Ten minutes of prep, then the oven does the rest.

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.notes: mixed colors, seeded and cut into strips

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack in the center.
Toss peppers, onion, and garlic on a rimmed sheet pan with 2 tablespoons olive oil, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer — crowding steams instead of chars.
Nestle sausages into the vegetables. Drizzle sausages with the remaining tablespoon of olive oil.
Roast until sausages are cooked through (internal temp 160°F) and the vegetables are soft with charred edges, 25 to 30 minutes. Turn the sausages once halfway through.
Drizzle with red wine vinegar if using — the acid brightens everything. Serve straight from the pan on crusty bread or alongside.
